verdict.rationale: Daily documents a managed global mesh network architecture that improves latency, packet loss and jitter for users around the globe. It also documents scale limits: large calls of up to 1,000 participants and up to 100,000 simultaneous calls. The evidence shows managed multi-region scale but not how the media layer distributes or cascades sessions across nodes or regions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the cross-node/region media routing or cascading mechanism, autoscaling behavior details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering
